## Purpose / scope

## Compatibility and migrations
- [ ] No undocumented change to public module/theme/storage contracts.
- [ ] Upgrade, backup and rollback impact considered.

## Verification
- [ ] Tests added or updated as needed.
- [ ] Composer validation / PHPUnit / PHP lint run (or explained).
- [ ] Docker/standalone smoke tests run when applicable.
- [ ] Documentation updated for user-facing changes.

## Security
- [ ] No secrets, private data, untrusted executable files or unsafe paths added.
